reviewStatus: Separate model-assisted source and pose review accepts limited opt-in preview; human and full family approval pending.

sources.name: march-ne
sources.scope: Opt-in Confederate A NE four-sample contact/passing visual preview; exact historical Gettysburg v10 only.
sources.annotationMethod: Fresh separate model-assisted inspection of all final native cells, calibrated against color-coded anatomical left/right native 3D guides. Manual pelvis X uncertain +/-8 native pixels; shared rowground Y +/-4px and cap tops +/-3px. One body reference across all four source frames. No physical skeletal, human or historical certification.
limitations: Narrow model-assisted visual gait and kit review accepts row-major contact/passing playback. This is not independent human, physical skeletal/ground contact or historical drill certification.

NE pelvis overlap partly hides the support chain; confidence in absolute anatomical attribution is lower than NW. Distinct passing support silhouettes and contact hip-chain exchange were reviewed against native blue-left/red-right guides.

Final body and uniform were reviewed afresh after every accepted image change. Requests to preserve untargeted cells or exact translations were not achieved precisely; invariant-pixel or surgical-edit isolation is not claimed.
Every native RGBA pixel is retained, with full equal cells and byte-for-byte PNG export. No mirroring, recoloring, crop, resampling or alpha cleanup.
A single source-wide body reference retains natural native body-span variation; no phase-dependent scale correction. Manual roots and cap measurements carry the stated uncertainty.
Low-alpha RGB residue remains; diagnostics at selected thresholds do not establish perfect transparency or exhaustive fringe absence.
Additional identities and missing bearings, recoil/settling, transition poses, melee, casualties and true standard bearers remain unfinished.

sources.name: actions-ne
sources.scope: Opt-in Confederate A NE stationary actions; exact historical Gettysburg v10 only.
sources.annotationMethod: Fresh separate model-assisted source inspection. Manual pelvis X uncertain by about +/-8 native pixels; row-shared sole Y +/-4px; cap tops +/-3px; actual tube mouth +/-4px. One body reference for all four cells. No human, anatomical or historical certification.
limitations: Four native equal cells copied byte-for-byte; no mirroring, recoloring, cropping, resampling or alpha cleanup.
Full fresh all-cell review after image generation; requested exact layout/size changes were not achieved precisely, and untargeted pixel preservation is not claimed.
Same-identity appearance and body-relative kit accepted for limited opt-in review; full family and default approval remain pending.
A held firing silhouette and two representative loading states do not establish recoil, settling, fingers, a complete verified period drill or melee/casualty states.
Hidden trigger, bore/socket and some hip relationships remain partly occluded.
Roots, caps and tube mouth are approximate manual registrations, and one source body reference preserves native pose-size variation without per-frame correction.
Low-alpha native RGB remnants remain unchanged; diagnostic thresholds are not exhaustive fringe certification.
